description.value: The Royal Scot Hotel & Suites is a full-service downtown Victoria hotel sitting steps from the Inner Harbour, offering everything from standard guestrooms to manor suites with full kitchens and separate sleeping areas. It explicitly markets itself as bike-friendly, with two dedicated bike lock-up areas and an on-site tune-up station on the property. A long-stay program and dog-friendly rooms round out an unusually flexible offering for touring cyclists planning an extended stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website's /hotel-amenities.php page explicitly states 'two separate bike lock-up locations' and 'a tune-up station to keep you road- or trail-ready,' confirming secure bike storage and basic tools. Free wireless internet is confirmed both on the amenities page ('free wireless internet access in all rooms and common areas') and in OSM (internet_access=wlan). Contact details (local phone 250-388-5463, address 425 Quebec Street) are corroborated by the website's contact and long-stay pages; the website also lists a toll-free 800 number not in OSM but that is an addition, not a contradiction.
concerns: Website lists a toll-free number (800-663-7515) not present in OSM tags; not a contradiction but OSM could be updated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating downtown Victoria hotel with a live website, confirmed contact details, and explicit cyclist-friendly amenities; clear candidate for the directory.
